scope: Sources and fixtures come from the independently versioned OpenMS4-cli, OpenMS4-topp and OpenMS4-test-data packages.
method: Tool transcribed from the pinned C++; the upstream invocation with -struc_elem_length 1.5 is reproduced and every intensity compared against the retained output. Observed maximum absolute difference over 132 intensities was zero.
evidence_tier: executed differential (tier 1), canonical comparison against retained C++ tool output
native_differences: The source accepts erosion_simple and dilation_simple as alternative implementations; they select the same native methods because this port has one implementation of each.
